include: The relayout an edit causes is part of that edit's history entry: one Undo takes back both the edit and the relayout.
During a drag, the relayout commands share the drag's gesture id, so the drag and its relayouts are one entry; entries are never merged by time.
Computed child positions and sizes are stored unrounded; rounding happens only when values are displayed.
The new frame properties (direction, gap, padding) come with a new schema version and migration step, and older files open with auto layout off.
Relayout changes the document through commands on the bus, not by editing nodes directly.
avoid: Recording the relayout as history entries separate from the edit that caused it.
Merging relayout or drag entries with a timer, debounce or time window.
Rounding computed child positions or sizes to whole pixels or display precision when storing them.
